scope: Local primitive/proxy correctness only; approximate prefill arithmetic. No TTS listening approval, no N1 candidate performance measurement or adoption.

algorithm.reused_RHS: Each4output RHS vector block is loaded once and reused for4prompt rows; no single-row int8_linear call or GEMV fallback.
algorithm.weights: Derived per-output q/scale from unchanged CPU FP32 exact-half parent source matrices; scale=maxabs/127 clampedmin1e-12.
algorithm.activations: Independent per-token maxabs/127, zero-token scale1, nearbyint(input*reciprocal) then clamp[-127,127].
algorithm.accumulation: Exact int32 SDOT withK<=65536 preventing signed32 overflow; FP32 dequant multiply-multiply-bias with FMA contraction disabled. Optional FFN1ReLU finalstore.
algorithm.layout: RHS[ceilN4,ceilK16,4,16], activation[ceilM4,ceilK16,4,16]; zeros in all row/column/K tails. OriginalK passed explicitly for strict shape validation.
algorithm.integration: Separate DSO/build/cache/loader; process_prompt-only MLP replacement inherits unchanged restoration/decode delegation. Original attention,QKV,out,norm and cache-management code untouched; arithmetic can still alter later KV values and voice.

tests.comparison: Bitwise exact to explicitly defined per-token W8A8 reference, not original FP32 output

first_validation_failure: Original packed tensor layout lost originalK within a16-column padded group, so a mismatching inputK could pass. Explicitinput_features argument fixes strict validation. Failure log retained locally; final four native tests pass.
next_gate: Separate fullTTS voice generation with original L reference/audio guards, user listening before actualN1 speed comparison. No speed claim from these unit tests.
